description: Package-only xz recoding of the FXCM2 PAQ5/PPMD100M cmix21 candidate. The executable, dictionary bytes, cmix compile flags, and compression behavior match cmix21_text_mmap_paq5_ppmd100m_fxcm2_rcm32_bufthirtysecond_minmaps_v1; only counted asset coding changes from gzip to xz through Python lzma.
hypothesis: The FXCM2 archive slope is the same as the gzip-packaged parent, while xz packaging lowers the counted program payload enough to improve the full-corpus ledger if the 10M archive slope remains competitive.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space

source.patch: CMIX_FXCM_CMC2_DIV and CMIX_FXCM_RCM_DIV added to src/models/fxcmv1.cpp; PAQ8 memory divisor hooks retained in src/models/paq8.cpp

verdict: Awaiting driver replay. Direct asset recoding lowers binary plus dictionary payload from 558,987 bytes to 471,808 bytes, a 87,179-byte counted-program reduction before wrapper delta, while leaving the compressor binary and dictionary contents unchanged.
